page.layout: One page of running text. Left margin holds two notes: "Assidua ebrietatis effectacer-tissima." beside the second and third lines, and "Crapula quid es unde?" beside the lower part of the text. Running head at top. Catchword "Gale-" at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: ifti verbis egregie simulant, sed ebrietas, & Assidua ebrietatis effectacer-tissima.quæ illam necessario confequuntur, turpitudo, ignominia, fanitatis viriumque corporis labefactatio, tremor, grauedo, pallor, linguæ titubatio, contentio extremitatum in neruis, torpor, vt plurimum vero refolutio. Et certè constat quotidianâ experientia, plærofque acrium illorum potatorum hoc tantum spectare, vt illos, quos vel amicitiæ, vel honoris specie, atq; simulatione ad immoderatè bibendum inuitant, atq; cogunt, cunctis deridendos propinentatq; comedédos, vt metaphoricós Terentius in Eunuco dixit, vt ita in totum dixisse liceat, nihil esse tam vtile, laudabile atque honestum, quod non deformet abusus hominum; quis enim non videt quotidie, antiquam illam propinandi confuetudinem ac philothefian amoris per se amicitiæque plenam, proindeque honestam, iam à multis seculis in turpissimum flagitiofissimumque abusum degenerasse, & ad Plutonis vsque Cancellos ipsos Christianos hodie fibi inuicem specioso amoris atque amicitiæ obtentu propinare. Atq; hinc promanasse putatur vox crapu-Crapula quid es unde?la, quæ pro ebrietate metonymicós vsurpatur, cumtamen proprie sit ebrietatis effectus capitis nimirum lucta, agitatioque, cum sc.ex temulentia caput aggrauatur & tremit.

page.notes: The page is printed in roman type with a long s; long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Words I am unsure of and which should be checked: "ifti" (possibly "isti"), "Eunucho" and "Cancellos" (the printed forms are close to these), "linguæ" (the printed word after "titubatio" is hard to read), "languitudo" not used, and "sc.ex" (the printed forms of "sc." and "ex" run together). Marginal note "Assidua ebrietatis effectacer-tissima." is set in italic in the print and its line break is unclear. The word "propinentatq;" and the phrase "comedédos" have doubtful letters. Ends at the bottom of the text block with the catchword "Gale-".
